task_completion.description: The agent successfully loads the chest CT scan into the medical imaging software (e.g., 3D Slicer).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing a CT scan loaded in the viewer with axial, sagittal, and coronal slices visible.

task_completion.description: The agent navigates through the slices to locate potential lung nodules.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent scrolling through different CT slices and centering the crosshairs on specific anatomical abnormalities.

task_completion.description: The agent places fiducial markers on identified nodules >=3mm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual markers (colored dots or glyphs) overlaid on the CT scan at the site of nodules; the 'Markups' list should show entries.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the fiducial markers to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A save dialog or terminal command showing the export of markers to '~/Documents/SlicerData/LIDC/agent_fiducials.fcsv'.

task_completion.description: The agent creates a report containing the lobe location and longest diameter for each nodule.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output showing a JSON structure with 'lobe' (e.g., RUL, LLL) and 'diameter' fields, saved to '~/Documents/SlicerData/LIDC/nodule_report.json'.

integrity.description: The agent used the medical imaging software GUI to identify and mark nodules rather than just script execution.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with Slicer tools, slice sliders, and the markup toolbar.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy-paste a pre-existing JSON report from a hidden directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen manually measuring diameters or typing the report based on observations in the viewer.

integrity.description: The agent used measurement tools (like a ruler or markup scale) to verify the 3mm threshold.
integrity.visual_evidence: The presence of a ruler tool or coordinate-based measurement visible in the GUI during the detection phase.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The LIDC-IDRI dataset defines nodules as being >= 3.0 mm in diameter. Only nodules meeting or exceeding this size should be marked and reported. Lobe abbreviations are: RUL (Right Upper Lobe), RML (Right Middle Lobe), RLL (Right Lower Lobe), LUL (Left Upper Lobe), and LLL (Left Lower Lobe).
